related.title: 懷拉基地熱電站
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水；懷拉基地熱電站改以既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment; Wairakei Geothermal Power Station centers on existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Geysers蒸汽儲層與Wairakei資源與歷史，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到懷拉基地熱電站，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以環境及微震monitor為起點，設計一項能區分「乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水」與「既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare geysers steam reservoir with wairakei resources/history and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Wairakei Geothermal Power Station, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from environmental/seismic monitoring and propose an observation distinguishing dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment from existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal, including uncertainty.

related.title: Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水；Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究改以公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment; Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research centers on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Geysers蒸汽儲層與EGS熱與連通，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以環境及微震monitor為起點，設計一項能區分「乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水」與「公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare geysers steam reservoir with egs heat/connectivity and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from environmental/seismic monitoring and propose an observation distinguishing dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment from public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統
history.text: 蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統的公開資料展示乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex illustrate dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將乾蒸汽、冷凝與資源補水改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns dry steam, condensation and resource replenishment into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
